summary.tldr: Requires victim notices about offender release and parole dates to include an explanation of how those dates were determined.
what_it_does: Requires information given to victims about eligibility and review dates for temporary absences and parole to explain how those dates were determined.
Requires information given to victims about release dates for temporary absence, work release, parole or statutory release to explain how the date was determined.
Requires the same date explanations for offenders under Part II of the Corrections and Conditional Release Act, including unescorted temporary absences and parole.
Requires release notices under Part II to explain how dates for unescorted or escorted temporary absence, parole or statutory release were determined.
Adds coordination rules so these changes work with another law on victims of violent offenders.
summary.background: Existing law already requires certain eligibility, review and release dates to be disclosed to victims. This bill adds an explanation of how those dates are determined.
